callback_timing.scope: CLOCK_MONOTONIC host intervals; callback delivery includes GPU/driver/queue; waiter interval includes callback signal and wakeup; neither is device execution time

timing_scope: Host clocks; first request excluded from warm medians; GPU device time not measured
numerical_scope: Actual-predecessor stage checks and final model plus quantized FP64 bound are acceptance; intermediate estimated model differences diagnostic; original FP32 application reported separately

reference_contract.guards: 128 bytes before and after each resident allocation payload; unchanged after every execution
reference_contract.correctness: Original application FP64 AND explicitly quantized schedule reported separately; bound is never widened to hide half quantization
reference_contract.repeat: At least three different source inputs; parameters/code immutable; reset all writable output payloads to a sentinel before execution

source_variants.rule: np.roll(source, iteration, axis=0), iteration=0..15; independent rows
